title: Output appended in one step
statement: Let $M$ be a Turing machine and let $c$ be a configuration for an input string. After one step from $c$, the output string is the output string of $c$ with the symbol emitted by that step appended, if a symbol is emitted; if none is emitted, the output string is unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
A machine with symbol alphabet and state set
An input string and configuration $c$ for that input
replaced:
For every multi-tape Turing machine $M$ and configuration $c$, the output
component after one step of $M$ from $c$ equals the output of $c$ followed by
the symbol emitted by that step, if any (and equals the output of $c$
unchanged when no symbol is emitted).
